subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – confirmation email and currency
body_text:
Hi Tara,

Thank you for speaking with us. You came to us because your webinar registration page was not sending the confirmation email and your products page showed the wrong currency.

What was completed during the call:
- We turned on the confirmation email for your webinar page and saved it.
- You registered once with another email address as a test, and the confirmation email arrived.
- You selected Indian Rupee in Settings, then Regional, and saved it, and your products page now shows rupees.

What we discussed:
- The currency is set in your account's regional settings, which only the account owner can change.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-12

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
